title: Sushi Pops Nacho Cheese
description: A fusion of sushi flavors with the crunchy delight of Yummi Pops Nacho Cheese.
ingredients: Surimi or strips of crab meat
instructions: Place the Nachos on a flat container. On top, place a piece of Sushi seaweed and a piece of Surimi.
Place chopped chives. And pour Siracha mayonnaise.
chef_tips: Use cold cream cheese so it holds its shape and is easier to handle when assembling.
Slice the surimi into thin, even strips to balance all the flavors in each bite.
Assemble the bites right before serving so the Yummi Pops stay perfectly crunchy.
